notes: There are 265 valid coordinates under RICHI-266. The four-letter XDXG group occupies source positions 190-193.
The primary model places the lost coordinate at boundary 190, the best fit constrained to that deficient group.

The broader body-only screen masks PARIS, UKRAINE and the entire footer. Its six globally tied minima are 181-186, outside the deficient group. All are retained, with their distinct raw texts and full repair prices.
The full-text stencil has three cheaper broad minima, 184-186. These are not silently substituted for the source-local model.

prior_attribution_check.scope: Bounded check of explicit body discussion, not a claim that no earlier researcher ever read these messages.

paper.title: Deciphering ADFGVX messages from the Eastern Front of World War I
paper.result: The paper explicitly discusses p221 A in the Mackensen section, but no explicit p221 B civilian-enquiry body discussion was located. The present edition covers only B1-B4.

dissertation.author: George Lasry
dissertation.result: The ADFGVX chapter explicitly cites p221 A, not this four-part B message; no explicit B body discussion was located in the checked text.

comments.result: No explicit p221 B, Wilson or civilian-enquiry body reading was located in the cached 55 comments.
